purpose: Detector-only CPU inference comparison (Q-PROTOCOL-compliant: no GPU lock taken, no pipeline renders, main server untouched)

models.lips_v1_SHIPPED: /workspace/ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox/lips_v1.pt sha256=ce9fe145... (byte-identical to payload of Civitai model 142240 file, zip sha256 dc37038e... matches Civitai API record)

method: ultralytics YOLO(model)(image, conf=0.05, device='cpu'); boxes sorted by confidence. MediaPipe: mp.solutions.face_mesh.FaceMesh(static_image_mode=True, refine_landmarks=True, min_detection_confidence=0.5), lips bbox = hull of FACEMESH_LIPS landmark ids.

files.yolo_compare_raw.json: all detections per model per image + mean CPU s/img
files.mediapipe_lips_vs_yolo.json: MediaPipe lips bbox vs lips_v1 top box IoU on the 13 taps

exclusion_note: results/run3/arms/R3_PC_mid_46/nTAP163__ftap163_00005_.png is a crash-guard test artifact: the face region is solid black (visually confirmed). Both lips_v1 (conf>=0.05) and MediaPipe FaceMesh return no detection on it. It is a correct-rejection control, not a detector failure, and is excluded from robustness statistics.
resolution_caveat: Inference ran on delivered 2688x3456 frames; in the pipeline the detectors see earlier-stage resolutions. Ultralytics letterboxes to imgsz 640 either way, so relative comparisons hold, but absolute confidences in-pipeline can differ (cross-check: run3 yolo_confidences.json recorded 0.9015-0.9021 for the same frames with face_yolov8m, matching this run's 0.9015-0.9028).
